Blocks.Text: Note
The latest API version is 202604. Use this version in the LinkedIn-Version header for all API requests to access the most recent features and improvements.

Candidates should be synced to the Middleware Platform whenever they are created or updated in your CRM. When a customer activates CRM Connect for the first time, you must sync all of their historical data to LinkedIn to power the integration.

To ensure the best possible ATS candidate to LinkedIn member match rate, sync phoneNumbers, linkedInProfileUrl, currentCompanyName, and currentJobTitle along with firstName, lastName, and emailAddresses whenever available.
Note
Please submit batch calls grouped with no more than 100 records in sequential order.
https://api.linkedin.com/v2/atsCandidates

curl -i -X GET "https://api.linkedin.com/v2/atsCandidates?ids%5B0%5D.atsCandidateId=atsCandidateTest100&ids%5B0%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B0%5D.dataProvider=ATS&ids%5B1%5D.atsCandidateId=atsCandidateTest200&ids%5B1%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B1%5D.dataProvider=ATS&%5B2%5D.atsCandidateId=atsCandidateTest222&ids%5B2%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1234567890&ids%5B2%5D.dataProvider=ATS" \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'X-RestLi-Protocol-Version:1.0.0' \
-H 'Accept:application/json'
Note
LinkedIn matches profiles asynchronously with respect to candidate creates and updates. If the matchedMembers field is ever null for a candidate, resend the request for that candidate in 60 seconds.

After your CRM receives a One-Click Export stub profile from LinkedIn and creates a candidate in your CRM, sync the newly created candidate in your talent CRM back to LinkedIn with the new Person URN in the manualMatchedMember field. You may use the sync candidates endpoint with the BATCH_UPDATE method to create or update the candidate.
Perform HTTP DELETE on the /atsCandidates endpoint when a customer deletes candidate records within the Talent CRM.

curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.linkedin.com/v2/atsCandidates?ids%5B0%5D.atsCandidateId=atsCandidateTest100&ids%5B0%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1000&ids%5B0%5D.dataProvider=ATS&ids%5B1%5D.atsCandidateId=atsCandidateTest200&ids%5B1%5D.integrationContext=urn:li:organization:1000&ids%5B1%5D.dataProvider=ATS" \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
-H 'X-RestLi-Protocol-Version:1.0.0' \
-H 'Accept:application/json'
A successful request will return a 200 OK response code, and you will find the status of each entity in the response body.

Synced candidates will be visible on a member profile in LinkedIn Recruiter via the In-CRM Indicator or CRM tab if LinkedIn was able to determine a match based on the synced candidate records. You can filter LinkedIn members by whether they are present in the CRM via the In-CRM Advanced Search Filter present in Advanced Filters.
